## Interpretation rules

- Each BaBra Lotion variant is 500 mL.
- Ingredient highlights are evidence-labelled and do not expose confidential formula percentages.
- Ingredient functions are not clinical proof of the finished product.
- Facial use must be supported for the exact variant; the current public evidence does not establish universal facial suitability and does not state a blanket prohibition.
- Retinol is a document match in the current manufacturer MSDS and label artwork for Signature for Her and Signature for Him.
- Retinol is not listed in the reviewed Soft Care for Kids MSDS or current label artwork.
- Rwanda FDA Import Licence RWANDA-FDA26/COS/SLIC/0469 authorizes BaBra Cosmetics Ltd to import Signature for Her, Signature for Him and Soft Care for Kids, subject to the stated import requirements and arrival inspection.
- Manufacturing certificates, company licences and product-registration status are separate categories.
- No US FDA product approval claim is made.
- Price, stock and delivery are confirmed through official purchase channels at the time of enquiry.
